twoFactorResetBody: An administrator reset TOTP for your OligInvest account: {issuedAt} (UTC). All sessions have been revoked. Your next sign-in requires TOTP setup again. If you did not request a reset, contact the instance administrator: {privacyUrl}
passwordResetBody:
We received a request to reset your OligInvest password.

Open this link within 30 minutes of the request:
{url}

If you did not send this request, ignore this message. Your password remains unchanged. After a password change, all sessions are revoked. TOTP will still be required when you sign in again.
securityNewDeviceSubject: OligInvest — new sign-in to your account
securityFailedSignInSubject: OligInvest — series of failed sign-in attempts
securityRecoveryStartedBody:
After a sign-in with a backup code, setup of a new TOTP started for your OligInvest account: {time} ({timezone}). Other sessions were ended.

If this was not you, contact the instance administrator: {url}
securityRecoveredBody:
A new TOTP and a new set of backup codes were configured for your OligInvest account: {time} ({timezone}). Previous backup codes are no longer valid.

If this was not you, contact the instance administrator: {url}
securityMassExportBody:
A data export of account {account} matched the unusual export rule: {reason}.

Time: {time} ({timezone})

Downloading this export requires a fresh TOTP confirmation. Event details are in the audit log.
securityMassExportReasonCombination: an export, a new PAT and a sign-in from a new device within 1 hour
